question: Does the MIND corpus pass the spec's L1-L4 admission gates when the gates are checked against the ACTUAL source documents the records name?
method: Each layer is computed INDEPENDENTLY against the source file the record cites. L1: the quote appears EXACTLY in the source. L2: the claimed magnitude appears literally in the quote (no unit-word escape). L3: the claimed [start_char,end_char) actually selects the quote from the source. L4: controlled vocabulary held AND the mechanism quote is in the source.
comparison_to_existing_gate: scripts/audit-l1-l4-admission-gates.ts reports 67.4% admitted (3,470 of 5,149). Its L1 checks only that the quote is non-empty; its L2 accepts a quote containing only a unit word; its L3 checks only end_char > start_char, which every record satisfies by construction; its L4 checks only that a mechanism quote is non-empty. None of them opens the source document.
